subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as a core sensitive-state artifact contract now, or keep it draft until the Scout/Lobster pilot and #94967 stress proof clarify the scope?
rationale: Automation can remove the lockfile drift and stale policy, but it cannot decide whether this new core backup/storage contract is the right product boundary for sensitive SQLite state.

options.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
options.body: Require the branch cleanup now and keep merge blocked until the reviewer accepts the core contract and the stress/pilot proof is sufficient.

options.title: Land Core MVP After Cleanup
options.body: Accept this as the first core snapshot artifact surface once the two patch defects are fixed and the known follow-up scope is documented.

options.title: Move Host-Specific First
options.body: Pause this core PR and route the safe-sync artifact workflow through a host/plugin proof before committing to a core CLI/API surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
recommendation.body: Require the branch cleanup now and keep merge blocked until the reviewer accepts the core contract and the stress/pilot proof is sufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee/reviewer for the PR and the remaining blocker is a product/security acceptance choice.
